english: A backpack you can set down and fill like a chest (48 slots).\nBreak it with a melee tool to pack it: it goes back in your inventory and the server keeps everything that was in it. Place any Storage Backpack to get it all back.

A packed Storage Backpack. Everything that was in it is kept safe on the server.\nPlace it anywhere to unpack it. It can be carried, dropped or given to a friend, and whoever places it gets the contents.
